title: Authentic Kullu Handwoven Woolen Shawl with Geometric Borders
name: Authentic Kullu Handwoven Woolen Shawl with Geometric Borders
description: Handwoven on traditional wooden pit looms using pure Australian Merino and local Angora wool. Features iconic multi-colored geometric mosaic patterns (Chhabri & Phool motifs) on both fringes, woven using the extra-weft technique.

title: Chamba Rumal Double-Sided Fine Silk Embroidered Wall Scroll
name: Chamba Rumal Double-Sided Fine Silk Embroidered Wall Scroll
artisan: Lalita Vakil (Padma Shri) & Chamba Craft Guild
description: A 16th-century courtly embroidery technique known as 'Do-Rukha' (reversible stitch), where untwisted silk thread is stitched onto unbleached hand-spun muslin to depict Krishna Leela and Pahari court scenes, appearing identical on both front and back faces.

title: Kangra Pahari Miniature Painting on Handmade Sialkoti Paper
name: Kangra Pahari Miniature Painting on Handmade Sialkoti Paper
description: Fine Pahari miniature artwork rendered with single-hair squirrel brushes using pure botanical and mineral pigments (lapis lazuli, malachite, real gold dust) depicting Radha-Krishna divine love framed by pine-clad Himalayan landscapes.

title: Kinnauri Intricate Geometric Patterned Pure Wool Shawl
name: Kinnauri Intricate Geometric Patterned Pure Wool Shawl
originHub: Kalpa & Reckong Peo, Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh
description: High-altitude tribal shawl incorporating complex geometric symbolism in 5 sacred colors (white, red, yellow, green, blue) representing the elements of nature according to Himalayan tradition.

title: Chamba Royal Hand-Stitched Leather Chappals with Metallic Thread
name: Chamba Royal Hand-Stitched Leather Chappals with Metallic Thread
description: Handcrafted vegetable-tanned leather footwear stitched with silk and metallic tilla thread, embellished with traditional floral embroidery originally designed for Chamba royal court members.

title: Himachali Traditional Velvet Embroidered Kullu Topi (Cap)
name: Himachali Traditional Velvet Embroidered Kullu Topi (Cap)
description: Traditional woolen cylindrical headwear featuring a vibrant handwoven Kullu geometric lace border (patti) on the front flap. A symbol of Himalayan pride and honor worn during festive ceremonies.

title: Lahauli Multi-Patterned Hand-Knitted Woolen Socks
name: Lahauli Multi-Patterned Hand-Knitted Woolen Socks
description: Distinctive high-altitude winter footwear hand-knitted from pure Desi sheep wool by tribal women of Lahaul, featuring traditional colorful geometric heel and toe motifs for thermal insulation.

title: Kangra Orthodox Whole Leaf Organic Black & Green Tea (500g)
name: Kangra Orthodox Whole Leaf Organic Black & Green Tea (500g)
description: Cultivated in the snow-fed foothills of the Dhauladhar range since 1849. Famous for its bright liquor, sweet woody aroma, and rich antioxidant profile, protected under European GI certification.

title: Chamba Temple Brass & Copper Mohra Sacred Face Mask Sculpture
name: Chamba Temple Brass & Copper Mohra Sacred Face Mask Sculpture
description: Hand-hammered brass and copper deity face mask (Mohra) used in Himachali hill temples and Kuldevta processions, crafted using 10th-century Maru-Gurjara metallurgical traditions.

title: Himachal Wild Apricot Kernel Oil (Chuli Oil - 250ml)
name: Himachal Wild Apricot Kernel Oil (Chuli Oil - 250ml)
description: Cold-pressed virgin oil extracted from wild Himalayan apricot seeds (Chuli) harvested above 2,500m. Exceptionally rich in Vitamin E, essential fatty acids, and traditional skin-soothing properties.
